Chicken Scampi
By: Anonymous
Published: Thursday, February 11, 2010 - 4:23pm

Ingredients




2 tablespoons Olive oil
4 Chicken breasts, boneless and skinless
1 teaspoon Garlic, minced
2 tablespoons Parsley, chopped
4 tablespoons Butter
To taste Salt and pepper

Preparation

1 Heat the oil in a skillet. Saute the chicken until just done. Add the garlic and cook for 1 minute longer. Add the parsley, butter and seasonings. Heat until the butter has melted. Serve the chicken warm (over pasta or rice) topped with the butter and garlic sauce.
